notes.title: Version 1.2.0 is out!
notes.notes:
After a small summer break, here is a new version with some nice additions and improvements, hope you'll like it!

Additions:
- add a new boss on floor 1
- add Rubber Duck item
- add Divine Retribution item
- add Golden Scepter item
- add Tornado item
- add Black Hole item
- add Magic Crystal item

Improvements:
- the Pyromaniac now uses a flamethrower instead of flame trails on dash
- add avatars to PNJs
- display boss marks in pause menu
- allow to long press left/right in menus
- the Lightning item now propagates the bolt to other enemies more often
- the Hacker hacking ability is now influenced by luck
- the Mix item now has effect on the Forge and Laboratory rooms
- better performances

notes.title: v1.1.2 is out with few improvements and bug fixes
notes.notes:
[b]Additions:
[/b]- Twin Projectiles item added

[b]Improvements:
[/b]- The Pyromaniac has been buffed (1 more dash, more DoT, less chances to see undesired items)
- The Mix item now also works for the Forge and Laboratory rooms
- You can not find Twin Projectiles and Triple Shoot items anymore when playing the Cyborg

[b]Bugfixes:
[/b]- The Demonic Chicken challenge has been fixed
- It is now impossible to obtain two times the Shield Assist item

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 is out!
notes.notes:
[h2]Additions:[/h2]
- Add the Demonic Chicken item and its associated ultimate challenge
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634514/489b80ddf8e8f35a0a7f552957930e36de4ee173.png[/img]
- Add the Pyromaniac character as the second base character
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634514/8579f8235492efd35af7b8fe3211dba2deec927e.png[/img]

- The Chest room now always gives you an item

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 is out! Ready to speedrun the game?
notes.notes:
New features:
- the player character's name and difficulty level now appears in the pause menu, allowing speedrun comparisons
- the timer pauses after beating a final boss and the boss's name is displayed in the pause menu

Modifications:
- taking an hit in Extreme difficulty will now remove a whole red heart (literally making the Condamned and the Summoner much harder to play)
- more enemies will show in hard and extreme difficulty
- the difficulty of endless mode now increases more rapidly
- when Playing the Condamned, you won't see any shield room anymore
- endless mode now provides less souls
- small performance optimizations

Bugfixes:
- the Gravitation item has been reworked to better works with some weapons

notes.title: Version 1.0 is out!
notes.notes:
I'm thrilled to announce the release of the 1.0 version! The game is now out of Early Access, but that doesn't mean there won't be more additions in the future since I'll continue to improve the game little by little. Enjoy this version and the new features!
If you like it please do not hesitate to say it on social networks or rate the game on Steam, it would help a lot.

[h2]Additions:[/h2]
- two new major bosses and a new way to end the game
- a new Skeleton character with the possibility to raise an army of skeletons
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634514/ee59e9fb93981292b6c88eaa3e6ac95ba186cf3d.png[/img]
- a new Endless mode
- a new menu to visualize all challenges
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634514/30fd09822d5061592b299f6c9976284ba02ce32a.png[/img]
- plenty of new challenges
- add the Trial room
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634514/c296f33c7c9e493467511e23996c41df5cf4af91.png[/img]
- add the Oblivion room
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634514/afe998aa03b933b75f6e2c3336bdb2aafcfd4e70.png[/img]
- add the Mirror item
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634514/117bb94335c630c61c9e04b45daf5ec622ce626c.png[/img]
- add the Hooligan item
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634514/683239ec169937ad2a001fe44540a9ca98c9968e.png[/img]
- add the Circular Saw Blades item
- add the Bones item
- locked rooms are now visible during the run

[h2]Modifications:[/h2]
- greatly increase the duration of the Divine Protection item
- reduce a bit the speed of the Knight boss
- the boss music wasn't looping
- Antimatter now also work with the Flail
- more balanced Vampire character
- less chance to see the same item twice in a run
- reduce a bit the damages done by the hacked enemies
- the first final boss is no Death anymore

[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]
- the price for the Crypt room wasn't correctly handled
- the boss music wasn't looping
- it was impossible to find one of the item listed in the "Secrets" menu
- several typos in both the english and french translations

notes.title: the 0.5.5 version is out!
notes.notes:
Here is a small update few quality of life improvements and bugfixes, without any new features or content.

- improve performances in some situations
- few graphical improvements
- the Chaos Cultist can't generate the floor restart and single-use healing items anymore
- the Chaos Cultist was sometimes increasing his number of items on reroll
- hacked enemies now correctly attack other enemies with landmines
- some items were not marked as discovered
- fix a possible weapon bug when using the Ghost item
- fix possibles bugs when spamming a button on screen transitions

Bugfixes:

- fix laser display issue

notes.title: Version 0.5.1 is out
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Here is a small release bringing few fixes and changes:
- fix: on some Windows computers, the game was totally black
- fix: the Condamned character was sometimes locked again after the 0.5.0 update
- fix: enemies spawn by the final boss added in 0.5.0 were not automatically shooted
- feature: the orbital projectiles now go through walls and barrels and are more efficient now
- balance: the Ghost item needs more time to recharge

However, there is a big underlying technical change and having feedbacks would be great! Does it start correctly for you? Does it display correctly? Are the performances impacted?

notes.title: The 0.5.0 "Welcome to hell" update is out! (with a 40% discount)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I'm glad to announce a new release which brings quite a lot of content with notably a new hellish floor to discover.

But before describing the changes, please note that there is a [b]40% discount during Steam Autumn Sales[/b]! It is a good time to test the game if you didn't already.

[b]New content:[/b]
[list]
[*] A new floor to discover, with another final boss and an alternative ending.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634514/e2d1cf9d32b1d0ff535b73b82f2794950ccb3b46.png[/img]
[*] A new character to unlock: The Chaos Cultist. For people who like to be surprised.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634514/f847a8c1ad51617e5449d99c55dae9d5fa436f5f.png[/img]
[*] There is now a way to become a ghost without being really dead
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634514/7288d3e23a6f47055c6bd038634f5a3e8c36df29.png[/img]
[*] A new item: The Assistance Drone. It provides a moving boost area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634514/ec1a5f4e5c2033c5bd49ed1be7cb42dd8e32e895.png[/img]
[*] Rooms can now have some obstacles like barrels or crates
[*] The Burning Arrows now let a flame trail behind them.
[/list]

[b]Quality of life:[/b]
[list]
[*] The player now emit a small light, improving readability (especially in multiplayer)
[*] Global performances improvement (especially with the Energy Balls)
[*] The secrets and pause menu now display the activable item types
[*] MULTIPLAYER: ghosts can now dash
[*] Small improvements of dialogs with NPCs/Signs.
[/list]

[b]Balancing:[/b]
[list]
[*] The difficulty level now also impact the number of enemies
[*] The Gift item is nerfed a bit since it now can also gives 50 souls
[*] The Midas's Hand has been nerfed and is now usable once per room
[*] The Pestilence boss has been sightly simplified
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Sacred Shield were not always protecting you
[*] Bosses were sometimes acting weird just after starting a new phase
[*] You were able to die even with some remaining fake hearts
[/list]

Bugfixes:
- fix display issues on the list of discovered items and run items

notes.title: The 0.4.0 "Please write a review" version is out!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Before describing the changes, I would like to kindly ask you all to write a Steam review if you like the game. It is quite hard to gain visibility on Steam and for now there is not enough review to even see the satisfaction percentage, and most players refer to this to decide if they want the game or not. So please help this game by writing a small review.

New features:
[list]
[*] Each characters now has a dedicated sprite
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634514/87d2a202e6e29169278e137939521a5148c26c7c.png[/img]
[*] You can now see all the items you have already discovered and see how many you still miss
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634514/e44c2592674208dde829431bd7decc1b9bff29d2.png[/img]
[*] You can now see your player stats and taken items for a run
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634514/cffe75691341968d6542664c19bb82b6025c5b16.png[/img]
[*] There is a new option to mute the sounds
[/list]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Several issues with gamepad detection
[/list]

notes.title: v0.3.3 - QoL and bugfixes
notes.notes:
- controller support has been greatly improved
- fix laboratory room since items were not actually effective
- heart room now gives 1 or 2 more hearts
- The Summoner now starts with 3 skullflames
- small simplification of Famine and War bosses
- difficulty modes now also affect the luck in the game (quantity of drop and item rarity)
- playing in Extreme can also unlock Hard-related unlockables items

notes.title: v0.3.1 - QoL and bugfixes
notes.notes:
- all assists (squirrels, frogs, flail, scythes and wisp) can now apply poison/bleed/fire
- increase warning size for some bosses's attacks
- rework a bit the dialogs to let the user better understand there is more content after beating Death
- add two difficulty levels
- rework floor 1 and 2 enemies to be better balanced
- fix a bug with the initial selected language in settings
